leverage.exposure: None, and none is being contemplated tonight. The balance is comfortably positive, the standing offer sits entirely inside available cash, and there is no leveraged position of any kind open. Even the raised ceiling being held in reserve for tomorrow's decision would be unwindable with days to spare before the next lock, and the branch that would require unwinding arrives with its funding sale already identified and already costing nothing on the pitch. There is no path visible from here that carries a negative balance into a matchday.

binding_gap: The gap is depth, not a position, and specifically a third forward. At exactly the legal minimum there is no bench, no flexibility and no ability to sell before buying, which is the constraint every other decision this week is downstream of. A third forward is the one addition that simultaneously fills that hole, unlocks a better formation, and pushes the squad's only pointless body out of the eleven — which is why both open buy calls point at the same slot and why the attacker outranks the defender despite the defender being the safer-looking asset.

verdict.detail: MD2 is locked and already being played, so the eleven is final and there is nothing left to do for it. The horizon jumped straight to MD3, a full week out, which makes this a deliberately quiet run. The one live thread is the standing Conté offer, and the right move on it is to wait rather than act: Hoffenheim are on the pitch right now and the listing resolves the following midday, so the next run gets to decide the bid with the result in hand instead of guessing tonight. No action is required from Georg before then.

sell.reason: No sale this run, and this is a hard constraint rather than a preference. The squad sits exactly at the legal minimum, so any sale at all drops it below a fillable formation and triggers the short-squad penalty. Every designated funding sale on the books therefore stays frozen until a buy lands first. The moment the Conté offer settles, the cheap midfield body becomes the clean funding leg: the three-forward shape that buy unlocks pushes him out of the eleven anyway, so selling him then costs nothing on the pitch while freeing his value. Selling the Mainz full-back instead would cost real fielded points and remains the worse leg.

buy.reason: Two candidates, both re-verified fit and starting today, and both already recorded: the Hoffenheim attacker with the live offer against him, and the Elversberg defender held as the designated fallback if that offer loses. The attacker dominates the defender on both points added and price, because buying him legalises a three-forward shape that drops the pointless body out of the eleven, while the defender only improves a slot that is already filled. Five listings arrived since the last run and none of them beats either. One is an expensive international whose points-per-euro sits among the worst on the board and who is unaffordable without selling a far better forward — he is logged as an avoid precisely because a familiar name attached to a respectable score is the shape that has trapped this ledger before. One is a defender with a negative score. The rest have no scoring record at all and falling values, which is the market saying what it thinks of them. The board is entirely house listings this run, so no seller's-choice logic applies anywhere and every contest is decided by the highest bid.

standing.name: Bambase Conte
standing.why: REVERSING AVOID Ad5tox1, SAID OUT LOUD - both of its two independent grounds have expired, neither was wrong when written. GROUND (2) "HE IS A SUBSTITUTE" IS DEAD: Ad5tox1 rested on magazin.comunio.de 03.09 leaving him out of the TSG XI (front three Lemperle/Daghim/Hlozek) and on his coming off the bench at Koeln 29.08. At7e5oh already conceded "bundesliga.com 04.09 now actually DOES start him"; this run confirms it independently - bundesliga.com "voraussichtliche Aufstellungen 2. Spieltag" published 04.09.2026 has Conte in the Hoffenheim XI on the right of midfield, TSG absentees only Asllani (Aufbautraining Knieprobleme) and Prass (Muskelverletzung), and he is absent from ligainsider verletzte-und-gesperrte. The 04.09 source is FRESHER than the 03.09 comunio XI that the AVOID was built on. GROUND (1) "TIMING KILLS IT" IS NOW MOOT, AND THIS IS THE REAL CHANGE: Ad5tox1 rejected him because he resolves ~2026-09-05T12:50Z, after the MD2 lock, "and the cash is committed to Makengo until then anyway". Makengo is LOST (Borussia Rumpelfuss 12.800.000 at 16:33:16Z), so the cash is free; and this run establishes that ZERO listings on the board resolve before 18:30:00Z, so there is no MD2 buy to compete with him at any price. Post-lock is not a defect any more, it is the only horizon that exists. THE POINTS CASE, WHICH At7e5oh GOT WRONG ON A FORMATION ERROR: At7e5oh dismissed the ATT candidates because Maina "could not enter the eleven behind Gregoritsch 195 and Guirassy 180". That assumes 4-4-2 and two ATT slots. Buying Conte makes the squad 12 = 1GK/4DEF/4MID/3ATT, which legalises 4-3-3, and 4-3-3 fields THREE attackers and only three midfielders - so Conte enters as the third ATT and AMOAKO (ap 0) drops out of the eleven. Fielded goes 1333 -> 1439 = +106, the largest single-action gain available. Checked against the alternative: 3-4-3 is worse (1410, benches Widmer 29 instead of Amoako 0), and Rohr at 9.651.515 gives only 5-3-2 = 1420 (+87) for more money, so Conte dominates him on both points and price. PRICE: prc is exactly mv 9.198.968 with ofc 0, and the standing doctrine (Hq9u3jx, H8t606f: uncontested clears at mv, 8 for 8) would say bid mv. DO NOT DO THAT - see this run's calibration HOLD. Makengo was ofc 1 with Georg alone in ofs at 08:45Z and still cleared at +60,76%, which proves ofc read hours before expiry does not predict the contest at expiry. Bid 10.400.000 = +13,06% over mv. A Kickbase listing is HIGHEST-BID-WINS (not seller's choice like a manager ask), so unlike the Makengo case a higher number genuinely does buy win probability. Cash 11.343.624 is the hard ceiling without a sale and leaves 943.624 spare at this bid; he can go to the full 11.343.624 (+23,3%) if he wants more certainty, and to ~14,8M only by also dumping Amoako and Widmer, which reopens the depth hole and is not recommended. NO LEVERAGE RISK EITHER WAY: resolution is ~2026-09-05T12:50Z, after the MD2 lock, and 11.343.624 - 10.400.000 leaves the balance positive, so MD2 cannot be zeroed by this.

killed_this_run.name: Robin Koch
killed_this_run.why: NEW KICKBASE LISTING 2026-09-04T12:41:54Z, prc exactly mv 24.285.098, ofc 0, st 0, mvt 1, exs 108979 resolving ~2026-09-05T22:57Z. DEF, tid 4 = EINTRACHT FRANKFURT (per CLUB MAP v2, retained here because Hu1ik0b was closed for slot pressure: tid 4 = Frankfurt, tid 5 = Freiburg — do not confuse them). ap 132. REJECTED ON EFFICIENCY AND ON AFFORDABILITY, and logged because ap 132 attached to an established international is precisely the shape that tempts a run into the Chabot/Kimmich trap. (1) POINTS PER EURO: 24.285.098 / 132 = 184,0k per fielded point. Every outfielder in Georg's squad is better — Gregoritsch 60,7k, ter Horst 60,5k, Onyeka 65,0k, Widmer 63,2k, Matsima 102,7k, Minjae 110,1k — and both live buy candidates crush him: Conté 9.198.968 / 106 = 86,8k, Rohr 9.651.515 / 87 = 110,9k. (2) HE WOULD NOT EVEN IMPROVE THE ELEVEN MUCH: as a fifth defender he makes the squad 1GK/5DEF/4MID/2ATT whose best legal shape is 5-3-2, and at ap 132 he enters ahead of Widmer 29 for +103 — fractionally LESS than Conté's +106 at a QUARTER of the price. (3) UNAFFORDABLE WITHOUT WRECKING THE SQUAD: cash is 11.343.624, so he needs roughly 13M of sales on top, and the only players worth that are Guirassy 30.479.722 (ap 180) or Nusa 26.660.682 (ap 226) — selling 180 or 226 to buy 132 is a straight loss before you count the two transaction spreads. (4) His ap 132 is a ONE-MATCH figure like every ap in this league (Hp0rkuf) and will regress. REVERSAL CONDITION: only if his mv falls under roughly 110k per point (about 14,5M at ap 132, or proportionally at whatever his post-MD2 ap turns out to be) AND Georg is holding idle cash he cannot deploy on a better efficiency AND he still projects as a Frankfurt starter on a source dated at that time. Being Robin Koch is not a reversal condition.

killed_this_run.why: BEST POINTS-PER-EURO ON THE BOARD ON PAPER AND STILL A NO. ap 99 on mv 7.335.505 = 74k per point, the cheapest points on the board, listed at exactly mv with ofc 0, resolves ~2026-09-05T08:35Z. REJECTED ON SELECTION, and note this is a DIFFERENT and better-founded reason than At7e5oh gave. At7e5oh rejected him because he "could not enter the eleven behind Gregoritsch 195 and Guirassy 180" - that reasoning is WRONG and must not be reused, because a third attacker legalises 4-3-3 and does enter the eleven (it is exactly the case for BUY 3204 Conte). THE REAL PROBLEM IS THAT HE IS NOT IN HIS CLUB'S XI: bundesliga.com "voraussichtliche Aufstellungen 2. Spieltag" 04.09.2026 leaves Maina OUT of the Koeln eleven, and - the part that makes him uninvestable rather than merely doubtful - he is ALSO not on Koeln's absentee list, which reads "El Mala, Dallinga (beide krank), Huebers, Sebulonsen, Waldschmidt". So he is fit, available, and left out on selection, with no documented reason. His ap 99 is therefore last-season-shaped or MD1-shaped and is not a forecast. DATE TRAP HANDLED: the only injury item on him is ligainsider 25.08.2026 "Maina hatte dabei einen Tritt auf den Fuss oder das Sprunggelenk abbekommen" - that is BEFORE the 31.08 cutoff and is not usable as current news; his absence from the 04.09 XI is the actionable fact and it stands on its own. Also absent from ligainsider verletzte-und-gesperrte. He is a strictly worse buy than Conte on every axis that matters: Conte is 106 fielded points and a CONFIRMED starter for 9.198.968; Maina is 99 nominal points and a confirmed non-starter for 7.335.505. REVERSAL: only on a dated Koeln XI (31.08.2026 or later) that actually starts him AND the ask at or below mv. Cheapness is not a reversal - it is already the cheapest thing on the board and that is why it is a trap.

killed_this_run.name: Joshua Kimmich
killed_this_run.why: THE BIGGEST NAME TO HIT THIS BOARD AND HE IS STILL A NO. New Kickbase listing 2026-09-04T10:25:13Z at prc 59.870.453 = exactly mv, ofc 0, st 0, stl [], ap 303 off 96 real minutes (2 assists, Bayern 5:1 Stuttgart MD1), mvt 1 but tfhmvt only +4.003 so the price is flat, not running. REJECTED ON THREE INDEPENDENT GROUNDS, any one of which is sufficient. (1) TIMING: exs 113171s resolves ~2026-09-05T18:11Z. That is 23h41m after the MD2 lock AND, decisively, after his own MD2 kickoff - Bayern are away at Schalke 2026-09-05T16:30Z per his own mdsum (t1 8 v t2 2). He cannot score a single MD2 point for Georg at any price. (2) POINTS PER EURO, and this is the durable objection: 59.870.453 / 303 = 197.6k PER FIELDED POINT. That is worse than every outfielder in the squad except Lokonga - Gregoritsch 60.7k, ter Horst 60.5k, Onyeka 65.0k, Widmer 63.2k, Matsima 102.7k, Minjae 110.1k, Bernardo 115.4k, Nusa 118.0k, Baumann 135.1k, Guirassy 169.3k, Lokonga 220.6k. Buying the most expensive asset in the league at the second-worst efficiency in the squad is the Chabot trap (Akjg62g) with a famous name on it. And per Hp0rkuf his 303 is a ONE-MATCH figure like every ap in this league and will regress. (3) EVERY FUNDING PATH SELLS MORE POINTS THAN HE ADDS. Cash is 4.187.522 and spending power 55.298.400, so he is NOT affordable without sales even on full leverage. The only two-sale combination that reaches 59.870.453 is Guirassy 30.479.722 + Nusa 26.660.682 = 57.140.404 + cash = 61.327.926, i.e. selling ap 180 + 226 = 406 to buy 303, a straight -103 before regression, and it leaves 11 players at 1GK/5DEF/3MID/1ATT which fills NO legal formation (every shape needs at least 2 ATT except 5-4-1, which needs 4 MID - he would be the fourth, so 5-4-1 survives at 129+482+ (303+139+44) +195 = 1292 vs 1395 doing nothing). Wider sales combinations only get worse. He would also have to be carried as a large negative balance into MD3 unless unwound, and per the standing mechanic a negative balance at matchday start scores ZERO. REVERSAL CONDITION, stated so a future run does not re-litigate this from scratch: he becomes interesting only if (a) his mv falls far enough that the ask is under ~120k per point, i.e. roughly 36M or less at ap 303, AND (b) Georg is holding idle cash he cannot otherwise deploy, AND (c) the listing resolves before a matchday he can actually play in. Being Joshua Kimmich is not a reversal condition.

movers.reason: No flip clears its cost this run. There is not a single manager ask anywhere on the board, below market value or otherwise, so the flip mechanism is not merely unprofitable, it is absent. Two rivals did run the house round trip this afternoon and each banked a rounding error on it; that is motion rather than points, and it is not a model to copy — least of all with the cash already committed to a live offer that matters far more than a fraction of a percent.

fitness.sweep: The squad is completely clear. The Elversberg pair — the midfielder already owned and the defender on the shortlist — both appear in the freshest probable eleven published for their fixture, and that club's only named absentees are two other players. The Hoffenheim target carries a fitness-confirming item published today, hours before kickoff, describing him as pushing for further starts, with no flag on the Kickbase side and no entry in the injury tables. Nothing anywhere in the squad or the shortlist needs watching on availability grounds.

blocked.name: Jordy Makengo

Cleared to Borussia Rumpelfuss at 2026-09-04T16:33:16Z for 12.800.000 against mv 7.962.354 = +60,76%, the highest premium ever measured on a Kickbase board listing in this league. Georg's standing bid was 9.000.000 = +13,03% and lost by 3.800.000. He was NOT a bad call on merit: three dated sources (Yahoo Sports 03.09.2026, Sports Mole 04.09.2026, Comunio 03.09.2026) all started him at left-back for Freiburg and two omitted Guenter from the XI entirely, and HOLD Hws3l8h read him at 85-90% to start with ap 90. He was correctly identified for six consecutive runs as the only pre-lock resolver on the board worth owning. HE WAS LOST ON PRICE, AND SPECIFICALLY ON THE ADVICE NOT TO RAISE. Hws3l8h, Hq9u3jx(B) and H8t606f(B) each told the run to hold at 9.000.000 on the ground that his listing was uncontested (ofc 1 with only Georg in ofs at 08:45:21Z) and that "an uncontested Kickbase listing clears at mv", so raising would repeat the Onyeka +54,37% error. See the calibration HOLD from this run: ofc is a snapshot and not a forecast, and because a Kickbase listing is highest-bid-wins rather than seller's choice, raising on one genuinely does buy win probability. If he is ever relisted, do NOT reuse the case above: re-verify his fitness and Freiburg selection from scratch on sources dated at that time, and note that whoever paid +60,76% has a large paper loss to recover and may ask well above mv, so require the ask to be justified by his ap at that point rather than by the 90 recorded here.
